days.label: Monday
days.text: Monday is the last gray one for a while, with clouds slow to break this morning before some sun sneaks out this afternoon and a high in the low 40s. Clear skies Monday night drop us to about freezing, so give the windshield a minute Tuesday morning. After that the week turns sunny, dry and mild, around 50 on Tuesday and the mid 50s on Wednesday and Thursday, with no rain or snow in the forecast through Thursday, and the Weather Service says it'll feel more like mid October than the week before Thanksgiving. Track it all week, with patio, swim, and sunset scores, at Burlington Right Now .
